jobs.summary: Implement required-context CI waiting, the shared environment-failure classifier, required-section stub refusal, and the durable ticket pipeline using the contract's injected callbacks. Add isolated fake-boundary tests for stage stopping, resume, bounded commits, required-only waiting and ship refusals, preserving existing ship behavior.

Implement shared environment preparation, strict dependency read/exec grants, streaming evidence sinks, codex retry helpers and manifest-check prompt guidance within the two adapter files. Test the exported helpers with fake processes and files, including privacy preservation, setup ordering, output-write retry vetoes and a maximum of one retry; C owns all swarm.mjs call sites.

Wire A/B interfaces into command dispatch, usage, run sync/evidence/retry, check classification, inspect tails and ticket callbacks, then implement both scaffolds with the existing validation and result paths. Add isolated fake-boundary CLI tests and the 1.42.0 release edits, limiting Workflow additions to two lines and preserving all fixed T80 names and behavior.
